title: MAC FM · Saturday 3 October 2026
description: MAC Fellas, morning. Flydubai Cargo just launched its first scheduled B737-800 freighter network. Three dedicated narrowbodies are entering the market. That’s significant. It adds specific regional capacity that might compete for e-commerce and specialized cargo flows previously reliant on belly space. Exactly. And while that happens, e-commerce growth is intensifying scrutiny on lithium battery safety. Right. Stricter regulatory review is placing lithium battery cargo under a sharper safety lens. Increased compliance could impact handling procedures and operational efficiency for carriers moving high-volume consumer electronics. Keep an eye on those shifts. Stay safe out there, MAC Fellas.

sources.title: Flydubai Cargo launches scheduled B737-800 freighter network
